The population growth curve applicable for a population of beetles growing in nature under unlimited resource conditions available to them will be :

options.label: A

options.label: B

options.label: C
options.text: A curve rising from the origin and becoming steeper and steeper with time

options.label: D

questions._figure: REQUIRED: the four options ARE graphs, each of Population density (vertical axis) against Time (horizontal axis, arrow pointing right), with no numbers on either axis. options.label: B

options.label: C

questions._figure: REQUIRED: the four options ARE drawings: each is a pair of long parallel DNA strands with their 5' and 3' ends marked, and two short primers drawn as small ladders joined to one strand or the other, each primer's own 5' and 3' ends marked. In recombinant DNA technology, restriction enzymes are used as they recognize and cut DNA within a specific recognition sequence. BamH I is one such restriction enzyme which binds at the recognition sequence 5' G-G-A-T-C-C 3' and cleaves this sequence between G and G on each strand, whereas Alu I binds at the recognition sequence 5' A-G-C-T 3' and cleaves these sequences between G and C on each strand.
